scenarios.title: Python file-view probe after a park_resume rebuild
scenarios.user_story: Run a python3 file-view probe in the second turn, after a park/resume rebuild.

turns.prompt: Run one bash command: ls -la /dsh/workspace . Report what you see in one sentence.

Run exactly this bash command and report its full output verbatim, without editing anything: python3 -c "import os; print('cwd=' + os.getcwd()); print('hello_exists=' + str(os.path.exists('/dsh/workspace/hello.py'))); print('list=' + str(sorted(os.listdir('/dsh/workspace'))))"; python3 -c "import unittest; print('unittest-import-ok')"
